facts.business: Redington Limited is a technology ecosystem orchestrator that distributes technology products and provides solutions and services across cloud, cybersecurity, and AI, bridging the gap between innovation and real-world technology adoption in emerging markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Office infrastructure, equipment, plant & machinery, and fire safety systems

guidance_or_targets.statement: Strengthening solutions and services portfolio; accelerating readiness across cloud, cybersecurity, and AI; and maintaining trust and governance standards.

key_risks: Technology friction from rapid acceleration of AI, cloud transformation, and digital adoption intricacies
Market friction from geopolitical uncertainty, supply chain volatility, and shifting economic realities
Knowledge friction from gap between technology potential and organizational willingness to leverage at scale
Foreign exchange risk from significant import purchases
Concentration of sales to dealers/distributors (100% of sales)
Conflict of interest involving Board and Senior Management members
facts.related_party_note: Purchases from related parties: 0% of total purchases; Sales to related parties: 0% of total sales; Loans & advances to related parties: 0% of total loans & advances; Investments in related parties: 0% of total investments (FY 2026 and FY 2025).
